name: Predicate Pushdown 1
sql: SELECT sub.c_name, sub.c_phone FROM (SELECT c_custkey, c_name, c_phone, c_mktsegment FROM customer) AS sub WHERE sub.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING';
expected_optimization: Push WHERE condition down into the subquery.

name: Predicate Pushdown 2
sql: SELECT sub.o_orderkey, sub.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT o_orderkey, o_custkey, o_totalprice, o_orderdate FROM orders) AS sub WHERE sub.o_orderdate > '1995-01-01';
expected_optimization: Push date filter down into orders subquery.

name: Predicate Pushdown 3
sql: SELECT p_name FROM (SELECT p_partkey, p_name, p_type FROM part) AS sub WHERE sub.p_type LIKE '%STEEL%';
expected_optimization: Push string LIKE condition down into part subquery.

name: Projection Pruning 1
sql: SELECT c_name, c_phone FROM (SELECT * FROM customer WHERE c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE') AS sub;
expected_optimization: Remove unused columns like c_address, c_acctbal from the inner SELECT *.

name: Projection Pruning 2
sql: SELECT o_orderkey FROM (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE o_orderstatus = 'F') AS sub;
expected_optimization: Only project o_orderkey from the inner query.

name: Projection Pruning 3
sql: SELECT n_name FROM (SELECT * FROM nation JOIN region ON n_regionkey = r_regionkey) AS sub;
expected_optimization: Eliminate unused columns from both nation and region.

name: Subquery Unnesting 1
sql: SELECT c_name FROM customer WHERE c_custkey IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE o_totalprice > 100000);
expected_optimization: Unnest IN clause into an INNER JOIN with distinct orders.

name: Subquery Unnesting 2
sql: SELECT p_name FROM part WHERE p_partkey IN (SELECT l_partkey FROM lineitem WHERE l_quantity > 40);
expected_optimization: Unnest IN clause into an INNER JOIN with distinct lineitems.

name: Subquery Unnesting 3
sql: SELECT s_name FROM supplier WHERE s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps_suppkey FROM partsupp WHERE ps_availqty < 10);
expected_optimization: Unnest IN clause into an INNER JOIN with distinct partsupp.

name: Join Reordering 1
sql: SELECT * FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey;
expected_optimization: Reorder joins to process smaller table (customer) earlier.

name: Join Reordering 2
sql: SELECT * FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN nation n ON o.o_custkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'FRANCE';
expected_optimization: Reorder joins to evaluate highly filtered small table (nation) first.

name: Join Reordering 3
sql: SELECT * FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey;
expected_optimization: Join supplier and part before joining the large partsupp table.

name: Aggregation Pushdown 1
sql: SELECT sub.o_custkey, SUM(sub.o_totalprice) AS sum_price FROM (SELECT o_custkey, o_totalprice FROM orders) AS sub GROUP BY sub.o_custkey;
expected_optimization: Push aggregation into the subquery to reduce rows flowing up.

name: Aggregation Pushdown 2
sql: SELECT sub.l_orderkey, COUNT(sub.l_linenumber) AS lines FROM (SELECT l_orderkey, l_linenumber FROM lineitem) AS sub GROUP BY sub.l_orderkey;
expected_optimization: Push COUNT into lineitem subquery.

name: Aggregation Pushdown 3
sql: SELECT sub.c_nationkey, SUM(sub.c_acctbal) AS total_bal FROM (SELECT c_nationkey, c_acctbal FROM customer JOIN nation ON c_nationkey = n_nationkey) AS sub GROUP BY sub.c_nationkey;
expected_optimization: Push aggregation into the JOIN subquery.

name: Redundant Join Elimination 1
sql: SELECT c.c_name, c.c_phone FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'MACHINERY';
expected_optimization: Eliminate join with nation because n is not used in projection, where, or group by.

name: Redundant Join Elimination 2
sql: SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_totalprice > 50000;
expected_optimization: Remove unused join to customer table.

name: Redundant Join Elimination 3
sql: SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_quantity FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate > '1996-01-01';
expected_optimization: Remove unused join to part table.

name: Filter Into Join 1
sql: SELECT * FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'HOUSEHOLD';
expected_optimization: Push filter c_mktsegment='HOUSEHOLD' directly into the JOIN ON clause.

name: Filter Into Join 2
sql: SELECT * FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%';
expected_optimization: Push filter p_type LIKE '%BRASS%' into the JOIN ON clause.

name: Filter Into Join 3
sql: SELECT * FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'GERMANY';
expected_optimization: Push nation filter directly into the JOIN ON clause.

name: Limit Pushdown 1
sql: SELECT sub.c_name FROM (SELECT c_name, c_acctbal FROM customer ORDER BY c_acctbal DESC) AS sub LIMIT 10;
expected_optimization: Push LIMIT 10 into the inner subquery to prevent full sort.

name: Limit Pushdown 2
sql: SELECT sub.o_orderkey FROM (SELECT o_orderkey, o_totalprice FROM orders ORDER BY o_totalprice DESC) AS sub LIMIT 5;
expected_optimization: Push LIMIT 5 into the inner subquery.

name: Limit Pushdown 3
sql: SELECT sub.l_orderkey FROM (SELECT l_orderkey, l_quantity FROM lineitem JOIN orders ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey ORDER BY l_quantity DESC) AS sub LIMIT 20;
expected_optimization: Push LIMIT 20 into the JOIN subquery.
